```{r}
# 2024 corrected buoy data
b22 <- read.csv(here("outputs", "buoy_corr_dm_2022.csv"))
b23 <- read.csv(here("outputs", "buoy_corr_dm_2023.csv"))
b24 <- read.csv(here("outputs", "buoy_corr_dm_2024.csv"))
b25 <- read.csv(here("outputs", "buoy_corr_dm_2025.csv"))

bsal <- read.csv(here("files", "buoy_ts_all.csv"))

weath <- read_csv(here("outputs", "enviro_weather_2025-04-14.csv"))
```

```{r}
b22 <- b22 %>% 
  select(date_corr, fl_med_day) %>% 
  distinct()

b23 <- b23 %>% 
  select(date_corr, fl_med_day) %>% 
  distinct()

b24 <- b24 %>% 
  select(date_corr, fl_med_day) %>% 
  distinct()

b25 <- b25 %>% 
  select(date_corr, fl_med_day) %>% 
  distinct()

b <- rbind(b22, b24)

bsal2 <- bsal %>% 
  mutate(measurementTime = mdy_hm(measurementTime),
         date = date(measurementTime)) %>% 
  filter(WaterSalinity_UQL == 2) %>% 
  group_by(date) %>% 
  summarise(mean_sal = mean(WaterSalinity)) %>% 
  ungroup()

btemp <- bsal %>% 
  mutate(measurementTime = mdy_hm(measurementTime),
         date = date(measurementTime)) %>% 
  filter(WaterTemp_UQL == 2) %>% 
  group_by(date) %>% 
  summarise(mean_temp = mean(WaterTemp)) %>% 
  ungroup()

bsal2 <- bsal2 %>% 
  left_join(btemp)
```

```{r}
b <- b %>% 
  mutate(date = lubridate::ymd(date_corr),
         year = lubridate::year(date),
         yday = lubridate::yday(date)) 

b <- b %>% 
  left_join(bsal2)

b2 <- b %>% 
  left_join(weath)
```

```{r}
bf <- b2 %>% 
  select(date, 
         year,
         yday,
         f = fl_med_day,
         s = mean_sal,
         t = mean_temp,
         ws = w_dm,
         wd = wd_dm,
         qt = Q_Total,
         qgm = Q_GM,
         qsm = Q_SM,
         qra = Q_RA) %>% 
  mutate(
    # Convert to meteorological convention (direction wind is coming FROM)
    # u = eastward component, v = northward component
    u = -ws * sin(wd * pi/180),  # Negative because wd is "from" direction
    v = -ws * cos(wd * pi/180),
    # Calculate SE component for each hourly observation
    se_component = (u - v) / sqrt(2)) %>% 
  filter(year %in% c(2022, 2024))


```

```{r}
# Prepare data for GAM
bf_gam <- bf %>%
  drop_na(f) %>%  # Remove missing fluorescence values
  filter(f > 0) %>%  # Remove negative/zero fluorescence if any
  mutate(
    year_factor = as.factor(year),  # Year as categorical variable
    # Create log-transformed fluorescence (often better distributed)
    log_f = log(f + 0.1)  # Add small constant to handle zeros
  )
```


```{r}
# Create matched dataset by removing the same dates from 2022
bf_gam_matched <- bf_gam %>%
  filter(
    !(month(date) == 3 & day(date) %in% 20:23) &  # Remove March 20-23
    !(month(date) == 12 & day(date) >= 5)          # Remove Dec 5 onward
  )

# Verify the matching
bf_gam_matched %>%
  group_by(year_factor) %>%
  summarise(n_days = n())
```

```{r}
# Simple GAM model
# Start with basic seasonal pattern + environmental variables
gam_model <- gam(
  f ~ 
    s(yday, k = 10) +           # Seasonal pattern (day of year)
    s(t, k = 14) +               # Temperature effect
    s(s, k = 8) + 
    s(qt) + # Salinity effect  
    s(se_component, k = 5) +    # SE wind component
    year_factor,                # Year as fixed effect (different intercepts)
  data = bf_gam_matched,
  family = gaussian(),          # Assuming normal distribution
  method = "REML"               # Better for model selection
)

# Model summary
summary(gam_model)

# Check model diagnostics
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
gam.check(gam_model)

# Plot smooth terms
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
plot(gam_model, pages = 1, residuals = TRUE, pch = 19, cex = 0.5)
```


```{r}
# Alternative with log-transformed response (often better for fluorescence)
gam_model_log <- gam(
  log_f ~ 
    s(yday, k = 10) +           
    s(t, k = 14) +               
    s(s, k = 8) +
    s(qt, k = 8) +
    s(se_component, k = 8) +    
    year_factor,                
  data = bf_gam_matched,
  family = gaussian(),          
  method = "REML"               
)

# Compare models using AIC
cat("Model comparison (lower AIC is better):\n")
cat("Regular fluorescence AIC:", AIC(gam_model), "\n")
cat("Log fluorescence AIC:", AIC(gam_model_log), "\n")

# Model summary
summary(gam_model_log)

# Check model diagnostics
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
gam.check(gam_model_log)

par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
plot(gam_model_log, pages = 1, residuals = TRUE, pch = 19, cex = 0.5)
```


```{r}
# Check residuals
gam.check(gam_model_log)
# Residuals vs fitted
plot(fitted(gam_model_log), residuals(gam_model_log))
abline(h = 0, col = "red")

# Check for temporal autocorrelation
acf(residuals(gam_model_log))
```

```{r}
# Extract and plot year-specific seasonal patterns

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(mgcv)

# Method 1: Predict seasonal patterns for each year
# Create prediction grid for each year
pred_data <- expand.grid(
  yday = 1:365,
  year_factor = c("2022", "2024")
) %>%
  mutate(
    # Set other variables to their mean values for prediction
    t = mean(bf_gam_matched$t, na.rm = TRUE),
    s = mean(bf_gam_matched$s, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_component = mean(bf_gam_matched$se_component, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# Generate predictions
pred_data$fitted <- predict(gam_model_log, newdata = pred_data)
pred_data$se <- predict(gam_model_log, newdata = pred_data, se.fit = TRUE)$se.fit
pred_data$upper <- pred_data$fitted + 1.96 * pred_data$se
pred_data$lower <- pred_data$fitted - 1.96 * pred_data$se

# Convert back from log scale if desired
pred_data$fitted_orig <- exp(pred_data$fitted)
pred_data$upper_orig <- exp(pred_data$upper)
pred_data$lower_orig <- exp(pred_data$lower)

# Plot 1: Log-scale seasonal patterns
p1 <- ggplot(pred_data, aes(x = yday, y = fitted, color = year_factor, fill = year_factor)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), alpha = 0.3, color = NA) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Year-specific Seasonal Patterns (Log Fluorescence)",
    x = "Day of Year",
    y = "Log Fluorescence (predicted)",
    color = "Year",
    fill = "Year"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(1, 32, 60, 91, 121, 152, 182, 213, 244, 274, 305, 335),
                     labels = c("Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun", 
                               "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec"))

# Plot 2: Original scale seasonal patterns
p2 <- ggplot(pred_data, aes(x = yday, y = fitted_orig, color = year_factor, fill = year_factor)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower_orig, ymax = upper_orig), alpha = 0.3, color = NA) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Year-specific Seasonal Patterns (Original Fluorescence Scale)",
    x = "Day of Year",
    y = "Fluorescence (predicted)",
    color = "Year",
    fill = "Year"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(1, 32, 60, 91, 121, 152, 182, 213, 244, 274, 305, 335),
                     labels = c("Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun", 
                               "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec"))

# Plot 3: Add observed data overlay
bf_gam$year_factor <- as.factor(bf_gam$year_factor)
p3 <- ggplot(pred_data, aes(x = yday, y = fitted, color = year_factor)) +
  geom_line(size = 1, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_point(data = bf_gam, 
             aes(x = yday, y = log_f, color = year_factor), 
             alpha = 0.3, size = 0.5) +
  labs(
    title = "Seasonal Patterns: Model Predictions vs Observed Data",
    x = "Day of Year",
    y = "Log Fluorescence",
    color = "Year"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(1, 32, 60, 91, 121, 152, 182, 213, 244, 274, 305, 335),
                     labels = c("Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun", 
                               "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec"))

# Method 2: Extract year differences
# Calculate difference between years
year_diff <- pred_data %>%
  select(yday, year_factor, fitted) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = year_factor, values_from = fitted, names_prefix = "year_") %>%
  mutate(difference = year_2024 - year_2022)

p4 <- ggplot(year_diff, aes(x = yday, y = difference)) +
  geom_line(color = "red", size = 1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(
    title = "Year-to-Year Differences in Seasonal Pattern",
    subtitle = "2024 - 2022 (log fluorescence)",
    x = "Day of Year",
    y = "Difference in Log Fluorescence"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(1, 32, 60, 91, 121, 152, 182, 213, 244, 274, 305, 335),
                     labels = c("Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun", 
                               "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec"))

# Summary statistics
seasonal_stats <- pred_data %>%
  group_by(year_factor) %>%
  summarise(
    peak_day = yday[which.max(fitted)],
    peak_value = max(fitted),
    min_day = yday[which.min(fitted)],
    min_value = min(fitted),
    seasonal_amplitude = max(fitted) - min(fitted),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

print("Seasonal Pattern Summary:")
print(seasonal_stats)

# Display plots
print(p1)
print(p2) 
print(p3)
print(p4)
```
```{r}
# Add year-specific seasonal patterns
gam_model_interaction <- gam(
  log_f ~ 
    s(yday, by = year_factor, k = 10) +  # Allows different seasonal shapes
    s(t, k = 14) +               
    s(s, k = 8) +    
    s(qt, k = 8) +
    s(se_component, k = 8) +    
    year_factor,                
  data = bf_gam_matched,
  family = gaussian(),          
  method = "REML"               
)

# Compare models
AIC(gam_model_log, gam_model_interaction)

summary(gam_model_interaction)
```
```{r}
# Now use the interaction model for predictions
pred_data_interaction <- expand.grid(
  yday = 1:365,
  year_factor = c("2022", "2024")
) %>%
  mutate(
    t = mean(bf_gam$t, na.rm = TRUE),
    s = mean(bf_gam$s, na.rm = TRUE), 
    se_component = mean(bf_gam$se_component, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# Generate predictions with the interaction model
pred_data_interaction$fitted <- predict(gam_model_interaction, newdata = pred_data_interaction)

# Plot the REAL year differences
ggplot(pred_data_interaction, aes(x = yday, y = fitted, color = year_factor)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  labs(title = "True Year-specific Seasonal Patterns (with interactions)")
```

```{r}
# Identifying what drove the year differences

# Step 1: Compare environmental conditions between years
env_comparison <- bf_gam_matched %>%
  group_by(year_factor) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_temp = mean(t, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_temp = sd(t, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_salinity = mean(s, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_salinity = sd(s, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_discharge = mean(qt, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_discharge = sd(qt, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_wind = mean(se_component, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_wind = sd(se_component, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

print("Environmental differences between years:")
print(env_comparison)
```

```{r}
# Publication Figure: Environmental Forcing of Interannual Phytoplankton Variability

library(tidyverse)
library(gridExtra)
library(mgcv)

# Panel A: Environmental conditions comparison
env_comparison_plot <- bf_gam_matched %>%
  select(year_factor, t, s, qt) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(t, s, qt), names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(
    variable = factor(variable, 
                     levels = c("t", "s", "qt"),
                     labels = c("Temperature (°C)", "Salinity (PSU)", "Discharge (m³/s)"))
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = year_factor, y = value, fill = year_factor)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~variable, scales = "free_y", nrow = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "(A) Environmental Conditions",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Value"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        strip.text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"))

# Panel B: Temperature distributions (your key finding)
temp_dist_plot <- ggplot(bf_gam_matched, aes(x = t, fill = year_factor)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_vline(data = bf_gam %>% group_by(year_factor) %>% 
             summarise(mean_temp = mean(t, na.rm = TRUE)),
             aes(xintercept = mean_temp, color = year_factor),
             linetype = "dashed", size = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "(B) Temperature Regime Differences",
    x = "Temperature (°C)",
    y = "Density"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

# Panel C: Temperature-fluorescence relationship
temp_response_plot <- ggplot(bf_gam_matched, aes(x = t, y = log_f, color = year_factor)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3, size = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(method = "gam", se = TRUE, size = 1.2) +
  labs(
    title = "(C) Temperature-Fluorescence Relationships",
    x = "Temperature (°C)",
    y = "Log Fluorescence"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# Panel D: Seasonal patterns with environmental overlay
seasonal_env_plot <- bf_gam_matched %>%
  mutate(month = month(date, label = TRUE)) %>%
  group_by(year_factor, month) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_fluor = mean(log_f, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_temp = mean(t, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = month, group = year_factor)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = mean_fluor, color = year_factor), size = 1.2) +
  geom_point(aes(y = mean_fluor, color = year_factor), size = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "(D) Seasonal Fluorescence Patterns",
    x = "Month",
    y = "Mean Log Fluorescence"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

# Combine all panels
final_figure <- grid.arrange(
  env_comparison_plot,
  arrangeGrob(temp_dist_plot, temp_response_plot, ncol = 2),
  seasonal_env_plot,
  ncol = 1,
  heights = c(1, 1.2, 1)
)
```

```{r}
# Model comparison statistics
model_stats <- data.frame(
  Model = c("Environmental only", "Environmental + Year interactions"),
  AIC = c(1225.403, 1121.423),
  R_squared = c("0.25", "0.43"),  # Update with your actual values
  Delta_AIC = c(0, 104)
)

print("Model Comparison Table:")
print(model_stats)

# Key finding summary for results text
cat("
KEY FINDINGS FOR RESULTS SECTION:

1. Environmental Differences:
   - 2024 was 0.5°C warmer on average (10.5°C vs 9.9°C)
   - 2024 spent", summary_stats$temp_above_10[2], "% of time above 10°C vs", 
   summary_stats$temp_above_10[1], "% in 2022
   - 2024 had higher salinity and lower discharge (more marine influence)

2. Biological Response:
   - Same temperature-fluorescence relationship both years
   - Higher fluorescence in 2024 due to more time in optimal temperature range
   - Model with year interactions explained 43% vs 25% variance (ΔAIC = 104)

3. Mechanism:
   - Environmental forcing rather than community change
   - Warmer, more marine conditions in 2024 enhanced phytoplankton productivity
")
```

```{r}
# Step 2: Extract individual smooth effects by year
# Create prediction grids for each environmental variable

# Temperature effects by year
temp_range <- seq(min(bf_gam$t, na.rm = TRUE), max(bf_gam$t, na.rm = TRUE), length.out = 100)
temp_pred <- expand.grid(
  t = temp_range,
  year_factor = c("2022", "2024")
) %>%
  mutate(
    yday = median(bf_gam$yday, na.rm = TRUE),
    s = mean(bf_gam$s, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_component = mean(bf_gam$se_component, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

temp_pred$fitted <- predict(gam_model_interaction, newdata = temp_pred)

# Salinity effects by year
sal_range <- seq(min(bf_gam$s, na.rm = TRUE), max(bf_gam$s, na.rm = TRUE), length.out = 100)
sal_pred <- expand.grid(
  s = sal_range,
  year_factor = c("2022", "2024")
) %>%
  mutate(
    yday = median(bf_gam$yday, na.rm = TRUE),
    t = mean(bf_gam$t, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_component = mean(bf_gam$se_component, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

sal_pred$fitted <- predict(gam_model_interaction, newdata = sal_pred)

# Discharge effects by year
qt_range <- seq(min(bf_gam$qt, na.rm = TRUE), max(bf_gam$qt, na.rm = TRUE), length.out = 100)
qt_pred <- expand.grid(
  qt = qt_range,
  year_factor = c("2022", "2024")
) %>%
  mutate(
    yday = median(bf_gam$yday, na.rm = TRUE),
    t = mean(bf_gam$t, na.rm = TRUE),
    s = mean(bf_gam$s, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_component = mean(bf_gam$se_component, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

qt_pred$fitted <- predict(gam_model_interaction, newdata = qt_pred)

# Step 3: Plot environmental response differences
p1 <- ggplot(temp_pred, aes(x = t, y = fitted, color = year_factor)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  labs(title = "Temperature Response Differs by Year",
       x = "Temperature (°C)", y = "Log Fluorescence (predicted)") +
  theme_minimal()

p2 <- ggplot(sal_pred, aes(x = s, y = fitted, color = year_factor)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  labs(title = "Salinity Response Differs by Year", 
       x = "Salinity (PSU)", y = "Log Fluorescence (predicted)") +
  theme_minimal()

p3 <- ggplot(qt_pred, aes(x = qt, y = fitted, color = year_factor)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  labs(title = "Discharge Response Differs by Year",
       x = "Discharge", y = "Log Fluorescence (predicted)") +
  theme_minimal()

# Step 4: Seasonal pattern differences
yday_pred <- expand.grid(
  yday = 1:365,
  year_factor = c("2022", "2024")
) %>%
  mutate(
    t = mean(bf_gam$t, na.rm = TRUE),
    s = mean(bf_gam$s, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_component = mean(bf_gam$se_component, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

yday_pred$fitted <- predict(gam_model_interaction, newdata = yday_pred)

p4 <- ggplot(yday_pred, aes(x = yday, y = fitted, color = year_factor)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  labs(title = "Seasonal Patterns Differ by Year",
       x = "Day of Year", y = "Log Fluorescence (predicted)") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(patchwork)  # For combining plots

# Function to extract smooth effects from GAM
extract_smooth <- function(model, term, n = 100) {
  # Get the range of the variable
  var_range <- range(model$model[[term]], na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # Create new data for prediction
  newdata <- data.frame(
    x = seq(var_range[1], var_range[2], length.out = n)
  )
  names(newdata) <- term
  
  # Set other variables to their means
  for (var in names(model$model)) {
    if (var != term && var != "f" && !grepl("year", var)) {
      if (is.numeric(model$model[[var]])) {
        newdata[[var]] <- mean(model$model[[var]], na.rm = TRUE)
      } else {
        newdata[[var]] <- levels(model$model[[var]])[1]
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Add year column if needed
  if ("year" %in% names(model$model)) {
    newdata$year <- levels(model$model$year)[1]
  }
  
  # Get predictions
  pred <- predict(model, newdata, se.fit = TRUE, type = "terms")
  
  # Find which column corresponds to our term
  term_col <- grep(paste0("s\\(", term, "\\)"), colnames(pred$fit))
  if (length(term_col) == 0) {
    term_col <- grep(term, colnames(pred$fit))[1]
  }
  
  data.frame(
    x = newdata[[term]],
    fit = pred$fit[, term_col],
    se = pred$se.fit[, term_col],
    lower = pred$fit[, term_col] - 1.96 * pred$se.fit[, term_col],
    upper = pred$fit[, term_col] + 1.96 * pred$se.fit[, term_col]
  )
}

# Simpler approach for seasonal effects by year
extract_seasonal_by_year <- function(model, data) {
  # Get unique years from the data
  years <- unique(data$year)
  seasonal_data <- list()
  
  for (yr in years) {
    # Create prediction data for this year
    newdata <- data.frame(
      yday = 1:365,
      year = as.factor(yr),
      t = median(data$t, na.rm = TRUE),
      s = median(data$s, na.rm = TRUE),
      qt = median(data$qt, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
    
    # Ensure factor levels match
    if (is.factor(data$year)) {
      newdata$year <- factor(newdata$year, levels = levels(data$year))
    }
    
    # Get predictions with error handling
    tryCatch({
      pred <- predict(model, newdata, se.fit = TRUE)
      
      seasonal_data[[as.character(yr)]] <- data.frame(
        yday = 1:365,
        year = as.character(yr),
        fit = pred$fit,
        se = pred$se.fit,
        lower = pred$fit - 1.96 * pred$se.fit,
        upper = pred$fit + 1.96 * pred$se.fit
      )
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat("Error predicting for year", yr, ":", e$message, "\n")
      return(NULL)
    })
  }
  
  # Remove any NULL entries and combine
  seasonal_data <- seasonal_data[!sapply(seasonal_data, is.null)]
  if (length(seasonal_data) > 0) {
    return(do.call(rbind, seasonal_data))
  } else {
    return(NULL)
  }
}

# Create individual plots
create_effect_plot <- function(data, x_var, x_label, title) {
  ggplot(data, aes(x = x, y = fit)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), alpha = 0.3, fill = "steelblue") +
    geom_line(color = "steelblue", size = 1) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.5) +
    labs(x = x_label, y = "Effect on Fluorescence", title = title) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 9)
    )
}

# Assuming your GAM model is called 'gam_year2' and data is 'bf'
# Extract smooth effects for environmental variables
temp_data <- extract_smooth(gam_year2, "t")
sal_data <- extract_smooth(gam_year2, "s")
discharge_data <- extract_smooth(gam_year2, "qt")

# Extract seasonal patterns by year
seasonal_data <- extract_seasonal_by_year(gam_year2, bf)

# Create individual plots
p1 <- create_effect_plot(temp_data, "t", "Temperature (°C)", "Temperature Effect")

p2 <- create_effect_plot(sal_data, "s", "Salinity", "Salinity Effect")

p3 <- create_effect_plot(discharge_data, "qt", "Total Discharge", "Discharge Effect")

# Seasonal plot with both years
p4 <- ggplot(seasonal_data, aes(x = yday, y = fit, color = year, fill = year)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), alpha = 0.3, color = NA) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("2022" = "#E31A1C", "2024" = "#1F78B4")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("2022" = "#E31A1C", "2024" = "#1F78B4")) +
  labs(x = "Day of Year", y = "Predicted Fluorescence", 
       title = "Seasonal Patterns by Year", color = "Year", fill = "Year") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

# Combine all plots using patchwork
combined_plot <- (p1 + p2) / (p3 + p4)

# Add overall title and improve layout
final_plot <- combined_plot + 
  plot_annotation(
    title = "GAM Analysis: Environmental Drivers of Phytoplankton Fluorescence",
    theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 14, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"))
  )

# Display the plot
print(final_plot)

# Save the plot
ggsave(here("figures", "fluorescence_gam_analysis.png"), final_plot, 
       width = 12, height = 10, dpi = 300)

# Print model summary for reference
cat("Model Summary:\n")
print(summary(gam_year2))
cat("\nModel R-squared:", summary(gam_year2)$r.sq)
cat("\nDeviance explained:", summary(gam_year2)$dev.expl * 100, "%")
```

```{r}
  t = seq(min(bf$t, na.rm = TRUE), max(bf$t, na.rm = TRUE), length.out = 100),
  s = rep(mean(bf$s, na.rm = TRUE), 100),
  qt = rep(mean(bf$qt, na.rm = TRUE), 100),
  yday = rep(mean(bf$yday, na.rm = TRUE), 100),
  year = rep("2022", 100)
)
temp_pred_2022$pred <- predict(gam_final, temp_pred_2022, se.fit = TRUE)$fit
temp_pred_2022$se <- predict(gam_final, temp_pred_2022, se.fit = TRUE)$se.fit

p1_2022 <- ggplot(temp_pred_2022, aes(x = t, y = pred)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = pred - 1.96*se, ymax = pred + 1.96*se), alpha = 0.3, fill = "#E74C3C") +
  geom_line(size = 1, color = "#E74C3C") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(x = "Temperature (°C)", y = "Effect on Fluorescence", title = "Temperature Effect - 2022") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# Combine plots - 2022

             top = "GAM Analysis 2022: Environmental Drivers of Phytoplankton Fluorescence")

       width = 12, height = 10, dpi = 300)
```
